question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Neck or nothing
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Under going great risks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"Neck or nothing"** means to take a very high risk, often with the understanding that if one fails, the consequences will be severe. (जान की बाजी लगाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He knew it was neck or nothing, so he decided to go all in with his startup idea.
 
 
 
• **"Under going great risks"** refers to engaging in actions that have a high potential for failure or danger, often with the hope of a significant reward. (बड़े जोखिम उठाना)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Under going great risks.
